summary: This RCA task was dispatched to diagnose and fix a stalled/looping worker task (the 'PRE-FLIGHT REJECTED (crontab_unauthorized_change, transient)' watchdog signature) and to register a reusable fix via superboss-register.py log-fix, but it produced zero real work: all five checkpoints in task.yaml show files_modified: [], completed_steps: [], and status: failed, with the branch HEAD sitting at the exact same commit as the merge-base with master (fa3d6fd) -- no commits were ever made on this branch, confirmed by comparing git rev-parse HEAD against local and origin master which are both materially ahead. PROGRESS.md explicitly says 'Not started'. The task never got past its own pre-flight gate (ironically blocked by the very signature it was supposed to fix), then the supervisor's PR-resolution logic failed twice trying to open a PR for an empty branch named 'master', and ultimately mis-adopted an unrelated, pre-existing PR (compliance-tracker#580) that actually belongs to a different task (the original 'chat-context/terminology/mode-pill' feature work referenced only in this RCA task's title) -- not any output of this task. No known_fixes row for the target signature was produced. There is no real diff to review and no evidence the stated success criteria were met.
issues: Zero files modified and zero commits across all checkpoints -- branch HEAD equals the merge-base with master, meaning no code change was ever made by this task.
Required success criterion (a known_fixes row logged via 'python3 scripts/superboss-register.py log-fix --signature "PRE-FLIGHT REJECTED (crontab_unauthorized_change, transient)"') was not produced.

task.yaml's adopted_existing_pr field points to compliance-tracker PR #580, an unrelated repo/PR belonging to a different task, mistakenly attached to this task by a supervisor PR-resolution bug (gh pr create failures against an empty 'master' branch) -- it must not be treated as this task's deliverable.

The task remains stuck in the same failure loop it was dispatched to diagnose: an RCA task about a crontab pre-flight rejection loop is itself blocked by that same pre-flight gate, so it never produced any real root-cause finding.
No PROGRESS.md content beyond 'Not started' -- no evidence of investigation into worker.log/systemd.log as the prompt required.
